frontier.hypothesis: Cell E's four seat divergences (p $a1->$a0, sh $a0->$a1, copy $v0->$a3, lnk $a1->$a2) are reachable by a modelled perturbation of local-alloc/global-alloc's inputs, and inverse.py will name the C lever that produces it.
frontier.mechanism: The residual is now typed RA on an instruction-for-instruction identical 127-insn stream (E-s29-5), which is exactly the input the solver suite was built for; the forward models are validated and inverse.py ranks minimal input perturbations that reach a given goal assignment and maps each to a C technique.
frontier.next_probe: Apply tmp/grind/func_80017848/s29/body_E.c, run tools/ra_solver/extract.py to produce the model.json for func_80017848 on that chassis, then python3 tools/ra_solver/inverse.py local (and global) <model.json> --goal with the target seats (pointer -> $a0/4, shift -> $a1/5, copy -> $a3/7, links -> $a2/6) --depth 2 --top 8. A NEGATIVE result is first-class: it means the seating is decided outside the modelled inputs and the next move is ALLOCDBG instrumentation of local-alloc's suggested-register pass on this chassis, not another spelling.

frontier.hypothesis: There is a spelling of combine escape 2 (combine.c:914-917) whose intervening set of p does NOT extend a value's live range into the loop body, which would buy both copies without the seat displacement cell E pays.
frontier.mechanism: use_crosses_set_p only requires that the pseudo used in the copy's SOURCE be assigned between the copy and the base add. Cell E satisfies it with the links load because links is the only other preheader value, but any assignment to p whose result dies inside the preheader would satisfy it equally while leaving p's live range short and the loop body reading a separate links pseudo at $a2.
frontier.next_probe: Price cells that reuse p for a preheader-local value instead of for links: (i) p reused to hold the base itself (q = p; p = (u8 *)(sh + (s32)q); loop reads p as base) - note this makes i3 SET i2dest's source, so check whether combine.c:1458's dead_or_set_p still fires; (ii) p reused to hold the loop-2 bound so the guard's own load assigns p; (iii) p reused as the loop counter carrier. Each must be measured for BOTH the copy's presence and the seat map, not just the score.

frontier.hypothesis: Escape 1 (a downstream second use of loop 2's copy) has an unpriced site inside loop 2's guard's own taken arm, above the copy, that costs less than the banked minimum of 6.
frontier.mechanism: The banked price table for loop-2 second-use sites is post-loop 19-22, in-body 6, pre-join 12, guard-consuming 6-28, and every entry sites the use either outside the arm or inside the loop body. A use in the arm but above the loop has never been priced, and it is the only region of the arm the table does not cover.
frontier.next_probe: Cells that place a second read of the copy pseudo between the guard branch and the base add - e.g. the loop-2 bound reloaded through the copy (t = *(s32 *)((s32)q + sh2 + 0x20)) so q is used twice in the preheader itself - measured on the candidate chassis, then diffed for whether the second preheader use materialises as an extra insn or folds into the existing addu v0,a1,a0.
